name: PdxChip
description: A small tag that can be selectable or removable, with variants, an avatar and group support.

members.name: removable
members.description:
Shows a × button — the chip's tab stop — named "Remove {label}", which emits pdx-remove. The
chip does not remove itself: the app removes it and owns focus afterwards (move it to the
next chip's ×, or the previous one), or a keyboard user is left on <body>.

members.name: selectable
members.description: A toggle button (role="button", aria-pressed): click, Enter or Space flips the `selected` model.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: value
members.description: Value passed in the remove event's detail for identification.

members.name: avatar
members.description: Avatar URL — renders a small circle image before the label.

members.name: variant
members.description: outline (the default), primary, success, danger, warning, info, tonal, or tonal with a colour.

events.name: pdx-remove
events.description: The × was pressed: the chip's value (its label when it has none) and its label.

events.name: selected-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `selected`. Does not bubble.
